newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish pharmaceuticals firms sale arouses interest.
newsitem.headline: Polish pharmaceuticals firms sale arouses interest.

text.p: The treasury ministry has received more than a dozen bids for stakes in two pharmaceuticals firms Polfa Krakow SA and Polfa Rzeszow SA, a treasury ministry official said on Thursday.
"There are more than a dozen offers to buy shares in both companies," Maciej Chojnacki of the ministry's press office told Reuters.
He declined to give any details and said the initial selection of offers was likely to be concluded so sooner than in two weeks.

The ministry invited bids for at least 10 percent stakes in the firms in January. It will earmark 15 percent of the shares in each company for employees and five for a planned fund to meet claims for property confiscated under communist rule.
